# `MSButton` and the button theme

## Recipe and theme

- The recipe is `buildButtonRecipe(MagicStarter.buttonTheme)`, not a const. `shapeClassName` sits where `rounded-lg` was in the base; `smClassName`, `mdClassName` and `lgClassName` carry the padding, minimum height and label type of a size.
- `secondaryBorderClassName` is the one colour field, because a border costs layout: `''` drops it, while `border-0` paints a hairline. Every other colour stays in the recipe as a semantic alias, so `useWindTheme()` derives nothing here and keeps the theme you set; `useTheme()` resets it.
- The default theme emits the previous classNames byte for byte; a test pins all 12 intent and size pairs.
- A caller `className` is appended after the theme and wins on any family it names.

## Size and hit area

- Below `lg` a 44 px hit area wraps every size (`kButtonMinTapExtent`) and adds nothing to a size already 44 px tall. From `lg` up the button is laid out as is.
- A 44 px size is `py-[11px]` plus `leading-[22px]`, not `min-h-11` alone: Wind gives the box a minimum height with no alignment, so the label sits at its top.
- With `fullWidth`, besides the `SizedBox` wrapper, `MSButton` adds `justify-center` to its className so the label stays centred; that also makes a stretched button fill a bounded height (a test pins it).

## Form and auth button strings

- `formTheme.primaryButtonClassName`, `formTheme.secondaryButtonClassName` and `authTheme.guestButtonClassName` carry no `rounded-*`, `py-*`, `text-<size>` or `border-*` token. The auth views hand the primary to an `MSButton` of `ButtonSize.lg`, and the social, guest and step-up provider buttons to a `ButtonIntent.secondary` one of `ButtonSize.md`, so geometry and the secondary border come from the button theme. A `border-*` colour token alone paints a hairline in Wind, so it cannot live in those strings.
- The strings keep `w-full`, the colours, `font-semibold` on the primary and `hover:opacity-90` on the secondary ones.
- A host that sets its own form or auth button strings keeps whatever geometry it wrote; it changes one string with `MagicStarter.formTheme.copyWith(...)`.
- The dialogs and the team settings invite button are raw `WButton`s on the modal theme and never read the button theme.

## Neighbours

- `MSHeaderAction` collapses to an icon-only glyph below `lg` and a labelled `MSButton` from `lg` up; `label` becomes the icon form's accessibility label rather than being dropped.
- `MSFormActions` is the cancel and submit footer of a form: `submitLabel` and `onSubmit` are required, `cancelLabel` and `onCancel` optional (null renders no cancel button). It wraps (`wrap`) rather than stretching, since a full-width `MSButton` hands the row an unbounded child.
